content.value: Sample of ${ \mathfrak { n } } = 5$ are taken from a manufacturing process every hour. A quality characteristics is measured and $\vec { X }$ and R values are calculated for each sample. After 25 samples have been analyzed, the results are:

$$
\textstyle \sum _ { i = 1 } ^ { 2 5 } \bar { X } _ { \iota } = 6 6 2 . 5 0 \mathrm { a n d } \sum _ { i = 1 } ^ { 2 5 } R _ { i } = 9 . 0 0
$$
The quality characteristics are normally distributed.
(i) Calculate the control limits for the X and R control charts. $\vec { X }$
(ii) Assume that both charts exhibit control. If the specifications are $2 6 . 4 0 \pm 0 . 5 0$ . Estimate the fraction nonconforming.
(iii) If the mean of the process were 26.40, what fraction nonconforming would result?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
